name: Mermaid CLI
description: Command-line interface and Node.js tool for converting Mermaid definition files into SVG, PNG, and PDF diagrams.

evidence.claim: Mermaid CLI is a command-line interface for mermaid taking definition files as input and generating SVG/PNG/PDF files.
Community MCP server available for rendering Mermaid diagrams from MCP clients and AI workflows.

notes: Mermaid CLI is an open-source command-line tool and local Node.js API rather than a hosted cloud platform with traditional API keys or OAuth. Community MCP servers exist for AI integration.
